title: AP error envelope

details.description: Native protocol detail codes are carried at details.code, not error.code. Other application-neutral JSON detail fields are allowed.

code.description: When a native adapter supplies a protocol code, it uses this field. The portable details map itself accepts arbitrary JSON and does not require code presence.
Optional registry-level code; do not invent a registered code for native errors.
